column1: # The device kernels and the C they mirror (the mirror rule, GPU design
# 2026-09-28 part 6; cuda/mirror.c, out/native/mirror, reads this). One line per fact:
#   KERNEL  root   FILE:NAME  a C item the kernel mirrors; the mirrored set is
#                  the roots with every function, macro, table and enum
#                  constant they reach by name (FILE is under csrc/)
#   KERNEL  cut    FILE:NAME  where that closure stops (the kernel does not
#                  mirror it: it reports it, or C runs it on both sides)
#   KERNEL  kept   PATH       compiled C: the list of functions the build kept
#                  (nw-roots), used instead of the roots when it exists
#   KERNEL  file   GLOB       files whose any change counts (the port itself,
#                  its capture, its gate's scripts), under csrc/
#   KERNEL  build  COMMAND    builds the kernel (from the repository root)
#   KERNEL  edit   COMMAND    the per-edit check of a lane working on the
#                  kernel: one recording's stored C side through the device,
#   KERNEL  quick  COMMAND    the gate a change that reaches the kernel runs
#                  in the merge trial, on the 3090
#   KERNEL  full   COMMAND    the nightly's gate over every recording
# A lane that ports a C function to the device adds its root here; a lane
# that renames a root updates it (make -C csrc mirror-check fails otherwise).
LIGHTING what  the light engine (World.updateLightByType and its drivers), cuda/lighting/dev.cuh, checked by engine/lightcap.c's capture
# a load the device reports (CL_ERR_LOAD); the capture and the profiler's hooks
# band storage: the device takes the chunk's home band (lighting/dev.cuh home())
# a band's nibble arrays held as one of the constants or its own pool slot (lane/chunkmem): the
# device's mirror keeps them inline (lightcap's layout), only the values are the light engine's
LIGHTING edit  make -s -C csrc gpu-lighting-check RECS=fight-skeleton-s1 DRIVERS=1
LIGHTING quick make -s -C csrc gpu-lighting-check RECS="combat-mobs-s1 fight-skeleton-s1 nether-trip-s1 s1chain-S8 idx-cwlight-s1 chat-build-s1 fight-ghast-s42"
LIGHTING full  make -s -C csrc gpu-lighting-check DRIVERS=1

CLIENTLIGHT what  the client world's light deferred to the device (engine/lightdefer.h, D8): the client world's calls and relight checks recorded, run by cuda/lighting/replay.cu's deferred mode (LC_F_AUTH) on the env's resident copy, written chunks back to the host (engine/lightcap.c defer_apply) at each sync; checked by tests/cwdigest.h against the host's run
# what is deferred and where the host syncs: a change here moves the order the device sees
CLIENTLIGHT full  make -s -C csrc gpu-lighting-client-check CWL_RECS=all
WORLDGEN what  raw chunk generation (overworld, Nether, End), cuda/worldgen/*.cu, and the gen-ahead seam (cuda/worldgen/ahead.c, engine/genahead.c)
# the Chunk constructor's sky map and the loads around generation run in C on both sides
WORLDGEN edit  make -s -C csrc gpu-worldgen-overworld-check DUMPS=seed1 SPAWNS=
WORLDGEN edit  make -s -C csrc gpu-worldgen-dim-check DUMPS="nether-42-small end-42-small" SPAWNS= DIM_NEGATIVES=
WORLDGEN quick make -s -C csrc gpu-worldgen-overworld-check DUMPS="seed1 sb-cave-42 mesa-123456789" SPAWNS=seed1
WORLDGEN quick make -s -C csrc gpu-worldgen-dim-check DUMPS="nether-42-small end-42-small" SPAWNS= DIM_NEGATIVES="caves construct"
WORLDGEN quick make -s -C csrc gpu-worldgen-ahead-check RECS="gen-walk-s42 nether-trip-s1 end-dragon-s1"
# the built stage: the constructor and the sky map WORLDGEN cuts, run where the
# chunk was generated, served by the env pool's device generation as bands
WGBUILT what  Chunk's constructor and generateSkylightMap over generated overworld chunks, cuda/worldgen/built.cu, taken by engine/genahead.c genahead_chunk_built
WGBUILT edit  make -s -C csrc gpu-worldgen-built-check DUMPS=seed1
WGBUILT quick make -s -C csrc gpu-worldgen-built-check DUMPS="seed1 sb-cave-42 mesa-123456789"
# TICK, S6 (the chunk loop) as the engine's own C compiled for the device
# (cuda/tick/tick.mk): the kept list is what the device build's nw-roots kept
# (cuda/tick/build.sh writes it), the roots stand in until a build made it.

TICK what  S6, the chunk loop (servertick_chunk_loop), and the world tick's other phases servertick_phase runs alone (S1, S2, S1T, S4, S5, SG: tick_batch --phases), the engine's C compiled for the device by cuda/tick/tick.mk
TICK quick make -s -C csrc gpu-tick-check RECS="combat-mobs-s1 fight-skeleton-s1 nether-trip-s1 s1chain-S8" S6_PHASES=S1,S2,S4,S5,S6,SG

RENDER what  the renderer (cuda/render/host.cu: the sky, the sections, the recorded passes, the translucent sections' quad order for the device mesher's meshes), the observation's frames and the judges' (cuda/render), checked against raster_obs_render and play's own frames (the ported functions: cuda/render/mirrors.txt)
# host work whose results reach the device as data (raster_obs.h): the
# section mesher (the device's own is MESHING), the stages and their threads,
# the culling, the recorder's storage, the overlays' geometry (recorded
# quads), the heap and the profiler's hooks
RENDER build make -s -C csrc gpu-render gpu-render-judge
RENDER edit  make -s -C csrc gpu-render-check RENDER_ARGS=cov-zoo-s1
RENDER quick make -s -C csrc gpu-render-check RENDER_ARGS="cov-zoo-s1 pix-sky-s1 pix-fluid-s1 idx-dragondeath-s42"
RENDER quick make -s -C csrc gpu-render-judge-check JUDGE_ARGS="cov-zoo-s1 idx-hudfx-s1 pix-sky-s1 idx-dragondeath-s42"
RENDER quick make -s -C csrc gpu-render-check RENDER_PREC=fast RENDER_ARGS="cov-zoo-s1 pix-sky-s1 pix-fluid-s1 idx-dragondeath-s42"
RENDER quick make -s -C csrc gpu-render-judge-check JUDGE_PREC=fast JUDGE_ARGS="cov-zoo-s1 idx-hudfx-s1 pix-sky-s1 idx-dragondeath-s42"
RENDER full  make -s -C csrc gpu-render-check RENDER_ARGS=--sample\ 2
RENDER full  make -s -C csrc gpu-render-check RENDER_PREC=fast

MESHING what  the device mesher (cuda/meshing: render_blocks*.c compiled for the device as they are by meshing.mk, kernels.c's runtime and kernels, fed by engine/meshfeed), every section pass byte for byte the host's, checked by cuda/render/gate.sh --mesh and pipe_gate --device-mesh 2
# the table mode (cuda/meshing/table.h): a standard block's, a liquid's, a door's faces apart, and
# the boxes of logs, fences and stairs (the C they transcribe; table_host.c holds each against it)
# the libm values the device looks up (render_blocks.h rb_trig): the host computes them
# the live world: the device reads the feed's copies of the chunk records, and the
# flower pots' plants the feed lists (meshfeed.c)
MESHING build make -s -C csrc gpu-meshing gpu-render
MESHING quick make -s -C csrc gpu-meshing-check MESH_ARGS="pix-fluid-s1 cov-blkgallery-s1 cov-foliage-s1 cov-mesa-s1"
MESHING quick make -s -C csrc gpu-meshing-check PERF=0 MESH_ARGS=pix-fluid-s1
MESHING quick make -s -C csrc gpu-meshing-check MESH_ARGS="--mesh-tab pix-fluid-s1 cov-blkgallery-s1 cov-foliage-s1 cov-mesa-s1"
MESHING full  make -s -C csrc gpu-meshing-check MESH_ARGS=--mesh-tab
